scripts.setup-infrastructure: docker compose up -d && docker exec cv-ai-ollama ollama pull qwen3.5:4b
scripts.setup: npm run setup-env && npm run setup-backend && npm run setup-frontend && npm run setup-infrastructure
scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend "npm run dev-frontend" "npm run dev-backend"
scripts.dev-all: npm run dev-infrastructure && concurrently -n frontend,backend "npm run dev-frontend" "npm run dev-backend"
scripts.prisma:generate: cd backend && npm exec prisma generate
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd backend && npm exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:db-seed: cd backend && npm exec prisma db seed
scripts.prisma:reset: cd backend && npm exec prisma migrate reset
